estimates.assumptions: Standard density for Thai red curry paste is ~5g per teaspoon; 2 tsp = 10g. Modest amount typical for paste in soup recipes.
Salmon fillets are typically ~120g each when raw (edible portion after trimming); 2 fillets = 240g total. Known calories used directly; assumes raw weight as added before cooking.
Average lime yields ~30-40ml juice; juice of 2 limes ≈ 20g (density near 1g/ml). Known calories for lime juice used directly.
A 'pinch' of sugar is conventionally estimated at 2g for nutritional purposes in recipes. Known calories for brown sugar used directly.
A 'bunch' of fresh coriander (cilantro) is typically 20-25g of usable leaves for garnishing a 4-serving soup. Known calories for coriander used directly.
